_comment: SOURCE file (hand-maintained, like artist_master_profile.json) — NOT pipeline-generated. Facts here were read off each opportunity's real page, not a search snippet. Applied by engines/manual_research_engine.py, which validates every record before it can touch opportunity data. Fill-only by default: an existing value is never overwritten unless a record sets "override": true. Allowed fields: deadline, fee, contact_email, submission_url.
